title: Quantitative assessment of Pb sources in urban–rural river sediments based on Pb isotopes and PMF and MixSIAR models
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2026, 28,256-267
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00509D, Paper
Shanshan Xi, Wei Wang, Lei Sun, Xing Chen, Jiamei Zhang, Fan Yu
The complex land use patterns in urban–rural rivers and the presence of diverse point and non-point source pollution pose significant challenges for tracing heavy metal(loid) sources in river sediments.
